notes: Self-declared '1+ speed', with treadmills you run on to raise the number and ten levels gated behind it — that is the Simulation stat-grind family, whose tell is that the number going up is the game, so Obby & Platformer is named second rather than allowed to lead and import a genre-wide P6 this build never needed. tier-ladder is the shape: ten training tiers of rising difficulty, each walled off until speed crosses a threshold, and I read the answer's 'stack them into a tower' as the spiral form tier-ladder already allows rather than as course-tower, which would have bought P6 and P2 for geometry that here is just ground. Deciding without a user, I took Stat Grinder whole because '1+ speed' names that loop outright: the treadmills are station-training, the ten harder levels are gate-progression, and trigger-rebirth sits at the far end of the last tier, which also gives the run somewhere to end. Added obstacle-jump and checkpoint-respawn from the Obby table for the actual obstacle content the word 'obby' promises, both of which route free.
